known_limitation: Recipe discovery is item-based only (no trainer table exists yet for Forever) -- pure trainer-only recipes with no representative item are missing from this dataset. Acquisition is unresolved for everything. Recipes already present in the live Classic Era client (e.g. Season of Discovery content, which ships within the classic_era client lineage, not a separate branch) are excluded -- this file is genuinely Forever-specific content only, diffed against Classic Era the same way foreverdiff.com does on this identical build.
